laneIdentity.focus: pure helper and CLI semantics for duplicate, malformed, missing-ref, stale-head, listed-checkout, detached, merge-aware, self-reference, deterministic, false-pass, and false-block behavior

covered: merge-aware synchronization cannot suppress a helper stale-binding finding
missingBlockingCases: named main checkout head differs from origin/main
read-only provider snapshot contradicts open implementation inventory

passingFailClosedCases: detached checkout exactly equal to origin/main

mergeAwareStaleBinding.note: Aggregation preserves the stale-binding helper finding when the cached observed ref differs from the record.

readOnlyProviderInventoryProbe.note: The explicit provider comparison key list omits openImplementationPrs, so contrary current provider evidence does not participate in the decision.

selfReferenceBoundary.note: This bounded guard does not recursively require its own not-yet-open PR. Completeness of unlisted branches remains explicitly deferred and is not treated as proof of a complete GitHub PR inventory.

networkAndMutationBoundary.observations: Local refs are read with git show-ref only; no fetch, network request, or provider mutation is present.

phase1Ci.resumptionAction: Remediate both P1 findings, freeze a successor exact head, invalidate this review, rerun impacted isolated review lanes, and let the coordinator own the one frozen-head Phase 1 CI execution.

reviewHeadSemantics: implementation tip immediately preceding the review-evidence-only commit

findings.evidence: With branch=main, checkout HEAD=c...c, and remoteMain=a...a, verifyCurrentTruthHeadBindings returns ok=true, context=main, and no findings. The CLI compounds this by defining mainMatches as synchronization.ok && (branch === main || mergeBase === remoteMain), so any named main checkout bypasses checkout-to-origin/main binding.
findings.impact: A stale or advanced local main checkout can report current truth clear while executing source and generated documents from a commit other than the authoritative origin/main head. This violates exact current-main binding and is a false pass at the merge gate.
findings.requiredResolution: Require a named main checkout to have HEAD exactly equal to origin/main, emit a stable BLOCKED_INTERNAL finding on mismatch, and add helper plus CLI regression coverage for named main behind, named main ahead, and detached exact main.

findings.evidence: An explicit sanitized read-only snapshot containing openImplementationPrs=[] contradicts the five recorded open implementation PRs, yet the command exits 0 with ok=true and no findings because openImplementationPrs is absent from the provider comparison keys.
findings.impact: Local remote-tracking refs can be cached. Even when current read-only provider evidence is supplied, a remote branch advance, closure, omission, or replacement is ignored, allowing a stale implementation inventory and head to pass.
findings.requiredResolution: Normalize and compare supplied provider open-implementation evidence by PR number, branch, head, and state; fail closed on missing, extra, duplicate, malformed, or mismatched entries; add CLI tests proving contrary provider evidence cannot be overridden by cached local refs. Preserve offline no-fetch behavior and identify whether live provider readback participated.

findings.resolution: The helper deterministically rejects duplicate, malformed, missing-ref, stale cached-ref, listed-checkout, and unresolved detached contexts. Merge-aware synchronization does not erase an existing stale-binding finding, branch names are converted to fixed refs only after validation, and no network or mutation call is present.
Self-reference does not false-block this not-yet-open control PR, but unlisted-branch completeness remains explicitly deferred to PR E and cannot be represented as current provider inventory proof.
